# contabo_kubernetes_oidc_documents (Data Source)

This data source computes the OpenID Connect discovery document and the JSON Web Key Set (JWKS) that a Kubernetes API server serves for its service account tokens. The data source does not call the Contabo API or the cluster. The documents are identical to the documents that the API server serves at `/.well-known/openid-configuration` and `/openid/v1/jwks`, so you can publish them in a public bucket and use the bucket address as the service account issuer. Cloud providers such as Microsoft Entra ID, AWS IAM and Google Cloud then trust tokens that the cluster issues.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Compute the issuer documents of a Talos cluster from its service account key.
# The documents can be published before the cluster exists.
resource "talos_machine_secrets" "this" {}

data "contabo_kubernetes_oidc_documents" "this" {
  issuer          = "https://eu2.contabostorage.com/${data.contabo_object_storage.this.s3_tenant_id}:my-cluster-oidc"
  public_keys_pem = [base64decode(talos_machine_secrets.this.machine_secrets.certs.k8s_serviceaccount.key)]
}

resource "contabo_object_storage_object" "jwks" {
  object_storage_id = data.contabo_object_storage.this.id
  bucket            = "my-cluster-oidc"
  key               = "openid/v1/jwks"
  content           = data.contabo_kubernetes_oidc_documents.this.jwks
  content_type      = "application/json"
  cache_control     = "public, max-age=60"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `issuer` (String) The service account issuer of the cluster, which is the value of the API server flag `--service-account-issuer`. The value must be an `https` address without a query, a fragment or a trailing slash.
- `public_keys_pem` (List of String, Sensitive) The keys that the API server uses to check service account tokens, in PEM format. A private key is accepted too; the data source only uses its public part and never writes the private key to an output. Accepted formats are `RSA PRIVATE KEY`, `EC PRIVATE KEY`, `PRIVATE KEY`, `RSA PUBLIC KEY` and `PUBLIC KEY`. List more than one key while you rotate the service account key.

### Optional

- `jwks_uri` (String) The address of the JWKS, which is the value of the API server flag `--service-account-jwks-uri`. The default value is `<issuer>/openid/v1/jwks`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `jwks` (String) The JSON Web Key Set as JSON. Publish it at the `jwks_uri` address.
- `key_ids` (List of String) The key ids in the JWKS. Service account tokens carry one of these values in their `kid` header.
- `openid_configuration` (String) The discovery document as JSON. Publish it at `<issuer>/.well-known/openid-configuration`.
